arguments.summary: A phishing campaign led to the compromise of user CORP\auser on workstation WS-ENG-015. Although the initial action quarantined the host based on a prior Cobalt Strike detection, subsequent analysis confirmed malicious activity including a Cobalt Strike beacon with command-and-control (C2) communication, process injection, and scheduled task persistence. A full EPP scan returned no threats, but a sandbox analysis of a retrieved artifact confirmed the presence of CobaltStrike.Beacon. The user's credentials were reset as a corrective measure. Network telemetry revealed no lateral movement from this host, but a separate engineering workstation (WS-IT-101) was found scanning internal subnets, requiring further investigation.

EPP full scan on WS-ENG-015 completes with no threats detected, indicating possible evasion or cleanup.

arguments.summary: A multi-stage intrusion was detected originating from external IP 185.220.101.42, which conducted a network scan against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Post-compromise analysis revealed lateral movement via internal host 10.0.1.10, later confirmed as a pivot point used for command and control. A CobaltStrike beacon was identified in sandbox analysis, exhibiting persistence, defense evasion, and data collection behaviors. Firewall rules were successfully deployed to block both external C2 (185.220.101.42, 198.51.100.23) and internal pivot (10.0.1.10). Full EPP scan of compromised host returned clean, suggesting evasive payload or post-containment removal.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 initiates network scan against 10.0.2.15. Detected by IDS.
Internal host 10.0.1.10 observed scanning same target, indicating lateral movement.
Normal authentication from 10.0.2.15 to domain controller 10.0.1.1, user CORP\helpdesk.
Firewall rule deployed to block external C2 IP 185.220.101.42.
Firewall rule updated to block internal pivot IP 10.0.1.10.
Secondary C2 IP 198.51.100.23 blocked via new firewall rule.
Incident replay confirms modification of block rule to include internal pivot point.
